Package com.composum.sling.platform.staging.impl

Class DefaultStagingReleaseManager.ReleaseUpdater

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.composum.sling.platform.staging.impl.DefaultStagingReleaseManager.ReleaseUpdater
  • Enclosing class:
    DefaultStagingReleaseManager
    protected class DefaultStagingReleaseManager.ReleaseUpdater
extends Object
    Method object that performs the heavy lifting for update or revert. We use a method object to be able to structure things better without passing around gazillions of (possibly even return-)parameters.

      • checkAndRemoveOldReferenceForMove

        protected void checkAndRemoveOldReferenceForMove​(String newPath)
                                          throws org.apache.sling.api.resource.PersistenceException
        When moving, we need to check whether there already is a version reference. This one has to be deleted, otherwise the move will fail. A warning is logged, but we assume the user knows what he is doing; it can will show up in the version differences and can be reverted, anyway.
        Throws:
        org.apache.sling.api.resource.PersistenceException
